title: plugin-charts: a dimensioned pie / donut / funnel / treemap / sankey widget with two measures draws only the first — the door accepts it, the chart binds `series[0]`, and nothing says the second was dropped
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect, class (a), with a measured reproduction. `reach:` public door + wrong answer: `{ type: 'pie', dataset, dimensions: ['stage'], values: ['revenue', 'cost'] }` is accepted by objectui's `DashboardWidgetSchema` and by `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0's (the dev measured all five types), and the dashboard renders only `revenue`. Reader who acts: triage first (grade, route, and whether it is a renderer fix or a spec refusal), then the seat that owns `plugin-charts`. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_01YLg8XqWGJ785fwQ5v4pH37`) from the os-dev report on objectui#8894 (comment `5943464320`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`; PR objectui#11416). ⛔ Not graded here.

## The defect (objectui `origin/main`)

- `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` binds one measure in its single-series arms: `const pieDataKey = series[0]?.dataKey || 'value'` (about `:2095`), and the same `series[0]?.dataKey` read at about `:1613`, `:2048`, `:2161`, `:2243`, `:2278`. The dev read the pie, donut, funnel, treemap and sankey arms at source; a scatter arm's docblock (about `:1338`) says it binds one measure by design.
- `DatasetWidget` hands every declared measure on as a series, so its "a declared measure is not rendered" diagnostic (objectui#8894, PR objectui#11416) cannot see a drop one layer down.
- Measured by the dev with a rendered probe (never committed): the pie above drew 2 sectors (`revenue` per `stage` bucket), no trace of `cost`, and no console warning.

## Why it matters

The query runs both measures, the door accepts both, and the widget looks finished while answering a narrower question than its metadata asked: the ADR-0049 declared-but-unenforced shape objectui#8894 closed for metric tiles and dimensionless charts.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Ruling D on objectui#8894 (maintainer 「同意」, comment `5643392537`) settled the same question for the metric family: "several numbers are a different visual", and the spec narrowed rather than the renderer inventing display semantics. Triage's answer `5921125865` applied it per type for the dimensionless arm (render where the spec names a rendering; refuse at the spec door otherwise, objectstack-ai/objectstack#20958). The same per-type reading here would make this a spec refusal of 2+ measures on these single-series types even with a dimension, plus objectui's mirror and an audible signal until it installs. A renderer that draws several measures in a pie is the other arm, with zero measured pull.

## Dedupe

The 800 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed (back to #3162, REST, grepped locally 2026-10-02): `series[0]` 0, `pieDataKey` 0, "pie … two/several measures" 0, `single-series` 0; `AdvancedChartImpl` 6 (all closed, about date shifts and unbound series keys, objectui#10396 the nearest: a series bound to a key no row carries); control `DatasetWidget` 27, objectui#8894 among them.

Dedupe words: `dimensioned pie two measures` · `series[0] only` · `pie drops second measure` · `single-series chart family multi-measure` · `AdvancedChartImpl pieDataKey`
